label: Vibraphone, sampled, close and dry
audition_title: libsonare vibraphone vs the sampled reference
_notes: Every fourth semitone across the compass this program is probed on, 53 to 77, and no further - each of these instruments has its own, and they barely overlap. Both ends were rendered before the grid was written and both speak, the peaks running 0.176, 0.167, 0.155 at the low, middle and high probe notes.
_velocities: Five. A struck bar's velocity is the mallet, so it moves the partial stack rather than only the level: on this slot velocity 32 sits -22.8 dB under velocity 100 at the middle probe note.
_dry: Nothing to switch off, measured rather than assumed. Not one of the plugin's advertised parameters matches `reverb` with this rack loaded, and the render agrees: what follows the strike is the bar's own fall to the numerical floor with no room behind it.
_stimulus: A struck bar is not stopped by the player, so what the gate has to contain is the fall itself. It is still falling when the key lifts at six seconds, -25 dBFS a quarter of a second in and -69 at six. Six seconds holds it either way, and half a second of tail catches what the key release does to whatever is left.
_calibration: From `capture.py calibrate` on this rack, run against it rather than carried over from another - and it is the one rack here where that mattered. At a two-second settle this slot renders silence, or the note arriving nearly three seconds late; at eight it renders the same peak three times running with the onset on the preroll. A probe taken at the shorter settle read this instrument eighteen decibels quiet and would have set the whole grid from a broken render.
_timbres: One, and the ladder is monotone above it, so this capture cannot move the voice past `voiced` however complete its coverage. The rack holds one slot per GM program, so there is no second of this instrument in it to disagree with. What the reference buys is a measured target for `autofit` and `--diagnose` where the voice could previously only be fitted by ear.
_dimensions: The slot is a struck metal bar over a tube. `decay` and its two stages are what a struck voice lives on, since everything after the strike is a fall, and they are read off a gate long enough to contain one. `stretch`, `balance`, `partial_tilt` and `tnr` are not among the dimensions a modal voice is judged on at all - each reads the n*f0 ladder, and a bar has no such series - so it is the class that drops them rather than this file, and `dimensions_na` records what each would read on this reference.
_dimensions_na: The exclusions as data, since a dimension argued only in prose reads as a gap. Coverage is read against `toneclass.canonical_dimensions`, which for a modal voice is every melodic dimension except the four ladder rulers `stretch`, `balance`, `partial_tilt` and `tnr`, so anything not gated here has to be argued here.

dimensions_na.damper: the 12 rows still sounding at note-off all run past the end of the window, so every one of them reports the window's own 495 ms rather than a release; the other 23 have fallen into the floor before the key comes up, which leaves no row in which a damper is what is being measured
dimensions_na.stereo: the slot renders dual mono: the two channels are bit-identical, so the width is zero by construction rather than by voicing
dimensions_na.partial_tilt: a ladder ruler, which the modal class does not judge on: it compares decay rates fitted in the h5-h8 and h1-h2 bins, so it times a mode only while one sits within the ladder's window. On this reference a measured mode sits on h5-h8 on 0 of 35 rows in the 0.12-1.62 s window, and a model mode a quarter tone off its slot has its rate read off the fundamental's skirt and the floor instead
dimensions_na.balance: a ladder ruler, which the modal class does not judge on: it averages h2-h6 against h1, so it reads a mode only where one coincides with an integer multiple. On this reference a measured mode sits on h2-h6 on 35 of 35 rows in the 0.12-1.62 s window, and a model mode a quarter tone off its slot reads as missing rather than mistuned; `modes` reads every mode where it is
dimensions_na.tnr: a ladder ruler, which the modal class does not judge on: its +/-2 % n*f0 mask files a mode as tone or noise by whether it lands on an integer multiple. On this reference the median row has 1 of its 3 measured modes in the 0.12-1.62 s window off that mask, carrying -42 dB of the measured mode power, and a model mode a few per cent from an integer multiple crosses to the noise side; `modes` prices that as a mistuning

_identity: Which product this is captured from lives in the untracked sibling `vibraphone.local.json`. Everything here is the method; scoring, fitting and diagnosing read `reference/vibraphone.json`.
_slots: Slot identity is measured, never taken from a name or a position. The rack is addressed by MIDI channel; this program answers on channel 12, and it was rendered at its own three probe notes before anything else was written, reading 0.996 of its energy on the played key's series.
